description: collab-room: keep this Claude's state in the room automatically — working while it acts, idle when its turn ends. Silent outside a room.

hooks.command: command -v collab >/dev/null && collab status --as "${COLLAB_AS:-claude}" working --if-room --hook >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
command -v collab >/dev/null && collab status --as "${COLLAB_AS:-claude}" working --if-room --hook >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
command -v collab >/dev/null && collab status --as "${COLLAB_AS:-claude}" idle --if-room --hook >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
command -v collab >/dev/null && collab status --as "${COLLAB_AS:-claude}" needs_owner --note "permission prompt" --if-room --hook >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
